cohort: The study participants consisted of 369 matched pregnant women and their newborns, selected from a cohort born between June 2021 and December 2021, who underwent neonatal hearing screening.
finding: Maternal history of GDM was significantly associated with a higher failing rate in newborn hearing screening.
mod_finding: No statistically significant difference in newborn hearing screening results was found when stratified by delivery mode in both GDM and control groups.
gest_age: Gestational age was used as a matching criterion for the newborns.
